audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Gwen Levels 2-3 and 2+ items, while the prose calls 1-3 'a genuine farm-race', 4-5 'your worst window' and says 'This is where Vayne reclaims it' late.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Skill/Skill/Vayne/Gwen/Gwen/Vayne and matches the prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text and Final Hour's effect was never described in the full layer.
audit.why: Final Hour (100/85/70s) grants AD, invisibility during Tumble, a reduced Tumble cooldown and more Night Hunter move speed — that is why the two-item Vayne stops being catchable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn was described as a 'wall-stun' with no statement of the condition, and Silver Bolts was described as counting attacks only.
audit.why: Riot on Condemn: 'fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back... If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them' — in open ground it is only a knockback, so the counterplay is positional, not a dodge. It is also a targeted cast at 550, which Hallowed Mist denies outright from outside. Riot on Silver Bolts: 'The third consecutive attack OR ABILITY against the same target' — Tumble and Condemn advance the stack, so breaking the chain matters more than dodging autos.
audit.corrected: Terrain condition, the 550 targeted range vs Mist, and abilities-count-too all written in.

audit.why: Condemn 20/18/16/14/12s is the longest cooldown in her kit and her only peel; Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2s and shorter again under Final Hour.
audit.corrected: Both written into the cooldown block and trading rules.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Vayne contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both fragile at 1. Silver Bolts only bites on the third consecutive hit — break the chain and her poke is nothing. Deny the last hits.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Vayne's Condemn is down.
edits.after: Silver Bolts counts abilities as well as autos, so Tumble and Condemn advance the stack too.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Vayne must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash contests, but Tumble is a 6s auto-reset that keeps resetting her spacing. A farm race, not a kill lane.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Condemn's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her window: no Mist yet, and Condemn only stuns if it slams you into terrain. Fight in open ground, never beside a wall.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vayne's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Condemn is targeted at 550 — from outside Hallowed Mist she cannot cast it. Bait it, drop the fog, then snip her paper frame.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Condemn's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — one clean Mist window is a kill on a frame that thin.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Vayne carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: She reclaims it. Final Hour grants invisibility on Tumble and cuts its cooldown, so the kite stops being catchable.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Mist or sidestep it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vayne Condemn (12-20s): it only stuns if the knockback slams you into terrain, so fight away from walls. - Tumble (2-6s): an auto-reset, and shorter again under Final Hour. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Vayne with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Vayne wastes Condemn — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Vayne with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if she turns. Great trade: Condemn is spent — no knockback for 12-20s, so commit the full pattern. Bad trade: taking three consecutive hits from her, which is exactly what procs Silver Bolts' %-max-HP true damage.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Mist or sidestep it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It only stuns into terrain. Fight in the open, away from any wall.

edits.before: Vayne wastes Condemn — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Condemn is targeted at 550, so the mist stops the cast.

edits.before: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Night Hunter gives her move speed toward you — you will not win a foot race.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The stun needs terrain. In open ground it is only a knockback.

edits.before: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Silver Bolts counts abilities too — three consecutive hits of any kind proc the %-max-HP true damage.

edits.before: Track Vayne's Condemn: Wall-stun. Mist or sidestep it. When it is down — Snip her in your mist.
edits.after: Condemn stuns only into terrain and is targeted at 550, so Mist denies the cast entirely.

edits.before: W-mist her condemn — Snip her HP and all-in early. Gwen wins by trading around Vayne's Condemn and cashing the pattern: w-mist her condemn and all-in early.
edits.after: Mist her Condemn — it is targeted at 550, so from outside the fog it will not cast. Break the Silver Bolts chain and kill her before three items.

notes: Condemn's stun is conditional on terrain collision, which makes the counterplay positional (fight in open ground) rather than a dodge — that was never stated. Silver Bolts also counts abilities, not just attacks, so Tumble and Condemn advance the stack. Note the full layer refers to Vayne as 'he' in several template strings I did not touch; worth a sweep.
